description: Screenshot of an Instagram post from the account ray.chandler showing a photograph of a security-camera monitor wall: a grid of at least 12 black-and-white CCTV feeds labeled Ch 3 through Ch 16, showing rooms, corridors and what commenters describe as bedrooms, with a timestamp beginning 2013/07 visible. The post is dated July 19, 2013 with 39 likes. The visible comments tie the image to Q post claims about Epstein Island and Pizzagate, with one commenter calling the account holder a 'gatekeeper'; these are user claims, not verified facts. The account is widely associated in Q-following circles with photographer Rachel Chandler, whose Instagram was referenced in Q drops.
